title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
lineage: MAR > ? > R @ 3 @ ips.  >  AKAI GX 625 > Apogee Mini Me(24/96) >Apogee MiniDac(monitoring/mastering) > Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44 via Apogee) > CD > EAC > WAV (TLH confirms no sbes) > FLAC (TLH)

ai_review.summary: Great audience recording captures the house sound and a scorching Dark Star → Spanish Jam jam with Peter Green, Duane Allman and Jerry Garcia dueling on stage.
ai_review.review: This audience tape delivers a vivid picture of the venue’s ambience, letting listeners hear the three‑guitar holy trinity in full. The performance shines around the Dark Star > Spanish Jam sequence, which reviewers describe as “smoking” and “beyond words,” while the overall sound is clear enough to distinguish each guest despite occasional fluctuations.

ai_rating.rationale: The show receives overwhelming praise for its historic lineup and inspired jamming, while the audience recording is noted as clear and authentic though not flawless; together this yields a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures the house sound and stage volume well, making Peter Green and Duane Allman audible. Some reviewers note occasional changes in clarity, but overall the tape is listenable and authentic.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally, highlighted by a seamless segue from Dark Star into the Spanish Jam/Love‑Light jam that many reviewers call the high point of the night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar duels with Peter Green and Duane Allman are repeatedly praised for their chemistry and interplay.
